caption: The drawing consists of a symmetrical arrangement of textile samples and an illustration on a beige background. In the center, there is a blue illustrative motif of a classical vase with ornate handles and a fluted base, holding a large, leafy bouquet of various flowers. Surrounding this central motif are six rectangular or square textile patterns. In the top left, there is a depiction labeled "REVERSE OF QUILT" showing a patchwork design, primarily in blue and brown tones. Below it are two smaller textiles, one labeled "TEXTILE OF REVERSE" in vertical brown and tan stripes, and another "TEXTILE OF REVERSE ACTUAL SIZE" with alternating thick maroon and striped bands bordered by floral sections. On the top right, a fabric swatch labeled "TOP OF QUILT" displays vertical brown and tan striped patterns. Below it, "TEXTILE OF TOP" is a dark brown swatch with blue and white floral motifs. The largest fabric on the right, labeled "TEXTILE OF TOP ACTUAL SIZE," has a beige background with red and pink floral designs interspersed with wavy red lines. Each textile sample is visually distinguished by its color and design, and all samples are arranged neatly around the central blue floral vase illustration.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
